_schema_notes: A HOLD is a stated reason plus a review date, never a withdrawal: the chip keeps status open in TASK_CHIPS.json; this file only says a plan of record deliberately parked it.

pause_pressure.py reads this file: an open authored chip listed here with review_after >= today is reported under open_chips_authored_held and EXCLUDED from the backlog arm's open_chips_authored trip; a hold whose review_after has passed counts again automatically (a hold is not a hide).
Regenerate from the wave plan's section 3 at each wave-planning session; delete an entry when the chip is released, resolved, or withdrawn.

review_after_basis: "derived" means the entry's own reason names something the hold is tied to (an external gate, a co-block, a successor design, a decide-or-leave call, a user-presence requirement, or standing-telemetry status); "default" means no such tie was found and the file's historical +7d cadence was used. See scripts/regen_hold_lane.py, the generator.
